verdict: Computations and derivations pass under explicit assumptions; scientific novelty and biological specificity unestablished. Bulk comparison is limited to a conservative scalar envelope procedure.
review_type: Independent agent computational/literature review, not external scientific peer review or biological validation.

numerical_checks.reviewer_method: Independent derivation and numerical checks; simulator functions not imported

optional_unknown_variance_sensitivity_no.model: Independent Gaussian log errors; common variance estimated from within-time independent wells. Pooled variance df=3(r-1); noncentral-t power computed by normal/chi-square quadrature.
optional_unknown_variance_sensitivity_no.r1: Variance cannot be estimated from within-time replicates when r=1.

derivations.contrast: C=T*(average log-growth slope over first interval minus average slope over second); it is a negative second finite difference.
derivations.recovery_model: Integrate Pprime/P=gP-b_inf*(1-exp(-t/tau)); constant and linear terms cancel, leaving b_inf*tau*(1-exp(-T/tau))^2.
derivations.known_variance: With independent common Gaussian log errors sigma^2=log(1+CV^2), variance of contrast is(1+4+1)*sigma^2/r. Common mean-log bias cancels.
derivations.unknown_variance: Pooled within-time residual variance has3(r-1) degrees of freedom and is independent of the mean contrast under Gaussian errors. The standardized contrast is noncentral-t under alternatives.
derivations.bulk_geometry: For constant rates with gP<=gS, N(t)=(1-w)*exp(gS*t)+w*exp((gP-b)*t), where w=f0*(gS-gP)/(gS-gP+b). Positive mixture implies convex logN and nonpositive C_N; degeneracy gP=gS,b=0 has C_N=0.

nonblocking_findings.assessment: Known-variance80% thresholds are correct but optimistic if precision must be estimated from few replicate wells. The separate reviewer sensitivity givesC=.47496687 for10%CV andr3, versus .39521832 with known variance; all assumptions remain idealized.

242/243 unique alternatives have their noiseless bulk contrast inside the constant-rate envelope; one exceeds its lower edge by only.00406649. Thus low bulk power is specific to this scalar summary and broad nuisance envelope, not a universal result about bulk data.

Continuous numerical minimization finds lower-envelope gaps up to5.38804e-6, versus smallest assumed contrastSD .0353333. Numerically negligible here; finite-grid and64-heldout checks are not a proof of uniform continuous-null error control.
Changing net proliferation, label retention, or state re-entry can curve logP without the proposed recovery mechanism. MoreP-only measurements do not distinguish exact equivalent trajectories.

Independent equal-variance Gaussian log errors, validated direct state abundance, no zeros and no biological replicate heterogeneity are stronger than ordinary experimental guarantees. For correlated errors usew-transposeSigmaw; average logs and log-of-average differ.

novelty_verdict: Prior art already covers log-growth transients, curvature-based identifiability, state-switching inference and experiment design. The exact elementary three-point precision calculation was not located in this bounded search; that absence does not establish novelty. Claim an original implementation and conditional precision illustration only.
new_review_sensitivity_status: Separately added analytical estimated-variance calculation; not part of frozen v2 simulation and not calibrated to biological data.
